name: International Protection (Refugee Status / Subsidiary Protection)

qualifying_event.description: The CGRS (Commissioner-General for Refugees and Stateless Persons) investigates applications and decides whether to grant refugee status or subsidiary protection status. Fedasil (the Federal Agency for the Reception of Asylum Seekers) handles reception and social/legal/medical/psychological guidance separately from the CGRS's decision-making role.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Application submission; CGRS interview and assessment; supporting documents.

requirements.blocker_text: CGRS assesses eligibility for refugee status or subsidiary protection status. Process steps and decision timeline were not confirmed at tier-1 precision in this pass.

evidence_required.document: Grounds for protection and supporting documents

outcome.duration_length: Refugee status: limited right of residence for 5 years. Subsidiary protection: duration not confirmed at tier-1 precision in this pass.

sources.title: CGRS (Commissioner-General for Refugees and Stateless Persons) -- International Protection: CGRS as decision-maker, refugee status = 5-year limited right of residence, Fedasil's separate reception role
